services.name: Boat tour
services.desc: Thank you for choosing Phillips Cruises & Tours to see Alaska’s glaciers and wildlife up close in Prince William Sound. We value the trust you have placed in us to deliver a safe, clean, and spacious day cruise on our large first-class, high-speed catamarans. For over 65 years, our Standards of Excellence have continued to lead the Alaska day cruise industry with our constant focus on every part of your journey. We are excited to see you! Our experienced team is ready to share the spectacular beauty of Prince William Sound with you! 5.25 Hour Cruise 12:00 PM - 5:15 PM, check-in 1 hour prior Complimentary hot meal Full-service bar and snacks available for purchase Self Drive: Depart
